HOD'S MESSAGE
Department of Biotechnology, KIT’s College of Engineering (Autonomous), Kolhapur. Established in 2002, the Department of Biotechnology at KIT’s College of Engineering (Autonomous), Kolhapur, is among the pioneering biotechnology programs in Maharashtra. The department offers B.Tech. in Biotechnology and M.Tech. in Biochemical Engineering and Biotechnology, providing a strong foundation in biotechnology, biopharmaceuticals, enzyme technology, fermentation processes, and advanced research. The curriculum is designed to blend scientific knowledge with practical and industrial applications, preparing students for careers in industry, research, and higher education.
Biotechnology has emerged as one of the fastest-growing sectors globally, driven by advances in healthcare, agriculture, environmental sustainability, and artificial intelligence. India’s biotechnology industry has grown significantly, creating vast opportunities in areas such as biomanufacturing, precision medicine, drug discovery, and bioinformatics. The department equips students with the knowledge and skills required to thrive in this evolving landscape through quality education, hands-on laboratory training, and exposure to emerging technologies. Over the years, the department has graduated more than 750 biotechnology engineers, with over 100 alumni pursuing higher studies at prestigious international universities. Graduates have secured positions in leading organizations such as Pfizer, Amgen, Biocon, and Dr. Reddy’s. Supported by strong industry collaborations, internships, research opportunities, and a dedicated alumni network, the department maintains an excellent record in placements and higher education. Student development is further enhanced through career guidance, professional certification programs, technical activities, and entrepreneurship initiatives, making KIT Biotechnology a preferred destination for aspiring biotechnology professionals.
Eligibility criteria:
Candidates must have studied PCM / PCB / PCMB. The minimum marks required are 45% for Open category and 40% for Reserved/EWS/PwD categories. Applicants must have a non-zero score in MHT-CET (PCM/PCB), JEE Main, or NEET.
